library.name: Marp Core
library.description: The core of Marp converter, turning Markdown into slide decks in the browser.

library.name: DOMPurify
library.description: XSS sanitizer for HTML and SVG, used on everything Marp renders before it reaches the page.

library.name: MathJax
library.description: Typesets formulas in slides to SVG, through Marp's MathJax plugin. Loaded only by decks that hold maths.

library.name: Shiki
library.description: Colours code in slides, through Marp's Shiki plugin with a curated set of languages. Loaded only by decks with a code block.

library.name: beautiful-mermaid
library.description: Draws Mermaid diagrams in slides as SVG, through Marp's Mermaid plugin. Loaded only by decks with a diagram.
